The benefits of using
Muscle & Motion

Here’s how we can enhance your understanding and expertise

See under the skin

Understand exactly which muscles are working (agonists) and which are stabilizing (antagonists) during any given movement.

Science-based insights

Trusted by over 300 universities, the platform serves as a powerful tool for educators and trainers to communicate with clients.

Injury prevention and form correction

By visually demonstrating "what not to do" alongside the correct technique, we help fitness professionals and enthusiasts train more safely and effectively.
